sources.title: Transmembrane BAFF from rheumatoid synoviocytes requires interleukin-6 to induce the expression of recombination-activating gene in B lymphocytes
sources.observation: Healthy-control B cells were cocultured with RA/OA FLS; RAG RNA/protein and functional assays plus BAFF and IL-6-receptor perturbations support laboratory-context reporting. Donor identity is external information absent from supplied P5.

sources.title: Soluble gp130 is the natural inhibitor of soluble interleukin-6 receptor transsignaling responses
sources.checked_locator: Publisher Abstract and Results: engineered BAF/3 response experiments/Figure4
sources.observation: Recombinant sgp130 inhibited soluble-receptor-dependent responses in the checked engineered-cell comparison, while the membrane-receptor response was spared. This resolves the molecular distinction, without proving a patient treatment benefit.
sources.access: Publisher full text readable through web tool; official PubMed index abstract readable, direct PubMed fetch HHS footer.
